hero.eyebrow: A little corner of the internet
hero.headline: Mostly Harmless.
hero.summary: I make games, build little worlds, and turn curious ideas into playful experiences. From 3D and mobile to VR & AR, there’s always something new brewing at my desk.
hero.note: A few games. A lot of curiosity.
hero.fallbackAlt: An illustration of Mostly Harmless wearing glasses at his wooden game-development desk with a monitor, coffee and a plant.
hero.imageAlt: Mostly Harmless seen from behind at his wooden desk, wearing black headphones with a glowing green skull, working across an IDE and a Unity voxel game on two angled monitors. A warm desk lamp lights his plant, coffee and wireless controller, with an open window overlooking Mumbai suburb apartment buildings and colorful window lights at night.
hero.caption: Probably making a game. Definitely making coffee.
